requirements.quote: Webhook endpoints per workspace, signed delivery with retries, fired on status, cause-list and order changes for watched items; worker delivery job registered in apps/worker registry and schedules tests.
Acceptance: webhooks fire on changes for watched items [integration].

every route added under the public API prefixes (`/v1/cases`, `/v1/causelists`, `/v1/orders`, `/v1/notices`, `/v1/webhook-endpoints`) must call `requireScope` with its scope and stay workspace-scoped.
Add a test that a key without the scope gets 403.
D-048 applies to what each route exposes (no resale of personal data); D-050 applies too (no judge ratings, rankings or predictions in any response).

deliverables.change: New tenantTable()s webhook_endpoint and webhook_delivery (FORCE RLS, workspace FK cascade, CHECKs for status and https url length); export from packages/db/src/schema/index.ts.
Export the webhooks schema.
Generate with pnpm db:generate (timestamp-named per D-051, not 0083): the two tables, RLS policies and owner-defined app_webhook_delivery_due(); Reviewed-by header; snapshot and journal.

deliverWebhook(url, body, headers): https only, refuse private/loopback/link-local addresses and redirects, timeout and response cap; export from packages/fetch/src/index.ts. Leave postWebhook (Slack) unchanged.
Export deliverWebhook.

New core domain webhooks: createWebhookEndpoint (secret returned once, audited), listWebhookEndpoints, deleteWebhookEndpoint, signWebhook (HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp.body), emitWebhookEvent (fan out to matching active endpoints in the workspace, content-free payload with ids, CNR, change kind, provenance and source_license; no party names, order text or judge ratings/rankings/predictions; no event for sensitive matters). Split into endpoints.ts, events.ts, sign.ts as needed.

Job webhook.deliver: re-read delivery and endpoint in the payload's workspace, sign, call deliverWebhook, record outcome; RetryableError for retryable failures (backoff), permanent failure marked failed, endpoint disabled after consecutive failures; once() against double send. Plus system.webhook.sweep (webhook-sweep.ts) that re-enqueues due pending deliveries via app_webhook_delivery_due on a cron.
Register webhook.deliver and system.webhook.sweep; export from packages/core/src/jobs/index.ts.
Export the new job definitions and schemas.

Add an optional injected onChange/emit dep called after a changed snapshot (status, new order), skipped for the first snapshot; no new core-domain import. Wire it in packages/core/src/jobs/definitions/status-poll.ts.
Wire emitWebhookEvent into pollCaseWatches deps.
Add an optional injected emit dep for new cause-list matches of a watch; wire in packages/core/src/jobs/definitions/causelist-poll.ts.
Wire emitWebhookEvent into the cause-list poll deps.

POST/GET/DELETE /v1/webhook-endpoints via defineRoute, each with requireScope('webhooks:write'), workspace taken from the principal (never from the body); responses never echo the secret after creation.
Mount the webhook-endpoints router.
Tests: key without webhooks:write gets 403 on every method, key with it works, a key cannot see or delete another workspace's endpoint, secret shown once.

Integration tests: a change on a watched item creates a signed delivery for a matching endpoint and not for another workspace or sensitive matter; signature verifies; payload has no personal data or ratings; deliver job retries then succeeds, permanent failure stops.

Add SERVICE_TESTS entries (or NOT_A_SERVICE with reason for pure helpers like signWebhook) for each new @causedeck/core export; add real cases in packages/core/src/__tests__/cross-tenant/services.test.ts.
Cross-tenant cases: B cannot list or delete A's endpoints; emit in B never delivers to A's endpoint.
Add webhook_endpoint and webhook_delivery to the root table list.
Add both tables to the RLS catalog; add TABLE_TESTS/registry entries and two-tenant seeders where the rls suite requires them.
Add the webhooks domain to CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES (audit, workspaces as needed) and add webhooks to the jobs dependency list; mirror in docs/engineering/core-domains.md.
Document the webhooks domain, its edges and the jobs dependency.
Add webhook.deliver and system.webhook.sweep to the expected job names (in registry order).
Add system.webhook.sweep to the expected schedules.
Tests: refuses http, private/loopback addresses and redirects; times out; posts signed headers to an https public host.

preserve.what: Slack postWebhook and its WEBHOOK_HOSTS allow-list in packages/fetch/src/webhook.ts stay unchanged; deliverWebhook is a separate function.

notifyStatusChanges behaviour (no alert on first snapshot or sensitive matter, dedupeKey) in packages/core/src/case-watch/alerts.ts and the PollCaseWatchesReport counts in poll.ts; new deps are optional.
apiKeyEnforcement and API_KEY_ROUTE_PREFIXES in apps/api/src/middleware/api-key.ts, and requireScope semantics in apps/api/src/lib/openapi.ts (cookie callers unaffected).
Existing migrations 0001-0082 and their snapshots; no edits to shipped migrations.

pnpm --filter @causedeck/core exec vitest run src/webhooks src/case-watch src/court/list-watch.test.ts src/jobs/registry.test.ts src/domains.test.ts src/__tests__/cross-tenant/services.test.ts

pnpm --filter @causedeck/worker exec vitest run src/__tests__/registry.test.ts src/__tests__/schedules.test.ts
pnpm --filter @causedeck/db exec vitest run src/index.test.ts src/__tests__/rls/sql.test.ts

decisions.choice: Outbound customer-URL delivery lives in @causedeck/fetch as a new deliverWebhook with SSRF guards, not an inline fetch in core.
decisions.justification: packages/fetch/src/webhook.ts:1-4 says only that package may call fetch on an external host (#479); core already depends on it, so no new workspace dependency is added.

decisions.choice: Change events reach the webhooks domain through optional injected deps wired in the job definitions, not a case-watch -> webhooks import.
decisions.justification: Mirrors StatusAlertDeps.enqueueDelivery (packages/core/src/case-watch/alerts.ts:18-22) and avoids a new CORE_DOMAIN_DEPENDENCIES edge (packages/config/eslint/core-domains.js:30).

decisions.choice: Retries use RetryableError + pg-boss backoff plus a cron sweep over an owner-defined due function; migration is timestamp-named.
decisions.justification: notification-deliver.ts retry pattern; app_case_watch_due/app_api_key_by_hash for cross-workspace reads (0081_api_keys.sql); D-051 in DECISIONS.md and packages/db/drizzle.config.ts for naming.
